# Applied by Buildroot under fakeroot when creating the target filesystem.
# Keep the repository copy user-owned; the generated image must be root-owned
# and not writable by group or other users for Dropbear's key checks.
#
# authorized_keys uses 'F' (optional -- skip silently if missing), not 'f':
# it only exists in rootfs-overlay-dev (dev builds), not the shared prod
# overlay -- 'f' would hard-fail makedevs (and the whole build) on prod,
# which has no such file to chown/chmod.
/root/.ssh                 d 700 0 0 - - - - -
/root/.ssh/authorized_keys F 600 0 0 - - - - -
